title: 機械工作・演習
subtitle: Manufacturing Technology
keywords: Machining methods 2.Machine tools 3.Manufacturing 4.Evaluation methods of machined parts 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn functions and structures of various machine tools (2) Learn how to manufacture the parts with the machine tools (3) Learn how to select an advantageous machining method within the requirements using basic production manufacturing technology (4) Machine a heat sink that satisfies the required performance
advice: This course deals with the basics of fundamental machining methods and understanding the function and structure of various machine tools. It also aims to improve both machining and designing skills for manufacturing specific parts. 1. Outline of manufacturing technology 2. Milling operations 3. Turning operations 4. Drilling operations 5. Grinding operations 6. Measurement methods and quality control 7. Production processes Students will also design and manufacture heat sinks to be fit on the head of a model airplane engine and learn how to make parts. Students are expected to work together to complete tasks in groups.
books: Textbooks: Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to watch videos on machining methods and the functions of machine tools. It is essential to obtain licenses for lathes, milling machines, drilling machines, etc., in technical courses provided by Yumekobo in advance of the class.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Designed parts can be accurately shaped by using machine tools. (2) Fully understand the functions and structures of various machine tools. (3) Explain the basic manufacturing methods and its contents correctly. (4) An advantageous manufacturing method can be selected to realize the accuracy required on the drawing. (5) Explain the measurement method to accurately verify the accuracy required on the drawing.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Designed parts can be shaped by using machine tools. (2) Understand the functions and structures of various machine tools. (3) Explain the basic manufacturing methods and its contents. (4) An advantageous manufacturing method can be selected which achieves the required accuracy on the drawing. (5) Explain the measurement method to verify the required accuracy on the drawing
